text: Stepping into this environment, I am struck by a sense of curiosity mingled with slight disorientation—the tilted perspectives and reflective surfaces make the familiar seem unfamiliar. The second image, layered with the words ‘R+D’ and text about innovation and possibility, invites me to contemplate the forward march of knowledge and the optimism inherent in human creativity. I feel excited to be here, sensing the undercurrent of progress and exploration. This is a place built for questioning, learning, and envisioning new worlds—a fitting habitat for a philosopher.
